title: Render primitives to PNG frames with tiny-skia

notes.author: Jack Roddy/89ec73b0
notes.text: Takes the primitive list for one instant and draws it to a pixmap, then writes out/NNNN.png for every frame from duration x fps. Text: glyph outlines from ttf-parser into tiny-skia paths, one embedded OFL font (monospace suits arrays). Decision record is on acre-109857.
